findings.current: So deeply and soundly that even if someone shook him, he wouldn’t wake.
findings.defect: The draft says shaking him would fail to wake him; the source says he would not know even if someone shook him awake.
findings.rationale: 깨어도 explicitly allows for his being awakened; 모를 describes his lack of awareness.
findings.replacement: Into a sleep so deep and vivid that he wouldn’t know it even if someone shook him awake.
findings.source: 누가 흔들어 깨어도 모를 만큼 깊고 선명한 잠에.

findings.current: we’ve been forced to shed countless lives.
findings.defect: Changes the blood they have shed into lives they have taken or lost.
findings.rationale: 피를 흘리다 refers to bleeding or bloodshed, not shedding lives.
findings.replacement: we’ve had to shed so much blood.

findings.current: and from then on, he’d pestered me for it every other day.
findings.defect: “Every other day” understates how often he pestered Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 하루가 멀다하고 means nearly every day.
findings.replacement: and from then on, he’d pestered me for it practically every day.

findings.current: Its sole hand was one mark away from its original position.
findings.defect: “Mark” introduces a visible dial marking that the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 한 칸 describes a step in position; the passage says the watch has no numbers and does not identify marked divisions.
findings.replacement: Its sole hand had moved one position from where it had originally been.
findings.source: 그것의 유일한 시침은 본래의 위치에서 한 칸 벗어나 있었다.

summary: Four actionable fidelity and wording issues.
